scope: Synthetic Workshop equipment catalogue. A Workshop asset tag is a unique identifier for ONE individual physical object, never a model or batch. The SAME tag means the SAME physical object. DIFFERENT Workshop tag values mean DIFFERENT physical objects.
entries: North projector: the individual physical object whose unique Workshop asset tag is W-104.
Hall beamer: another name for the individual physical object whose unique Workshop asset tag is W-104.
Spare projector: the individual physical object whose unique Workshop asset tag is W-209.
